description: Displays semantic modeling elements grouped by type with live filtering and selection.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the tree root.

parameters.name: CollapsedGroups
parameters.description: Optional two-way binding of the collapsed group keys. Seeded from when the instance is given a new collection; every user toggle raises CollapsedGroupsChanged with a fresh snapshot. The parameter is NEVER assigned inside the component.

parameters.name: CollapsedGroupsChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user collapses or expands a group (not while a filter drives the transient state).

parameters.name: Elements
parameters.description: Elements rendered by the tree. They are grouped by SemanticType.

parameters.name: OnElementDragEnded
parameters.description: Raised when the user ends a drag operation from a tree node.

parameters.name: OnElementDragStarted
parameters.description: Raised when the user starts dragging an element node. Reserved for canvas drop support.

parameters.name: OnElementSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an element node.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__group-header
cssClasses.description: MO4 disclosure header: a real button with aria-expanded/aria-controls; Enter/Space native, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight collapse/expand.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__group-chevron
cssClasses.description: Chevron icon that rotates -90deg when the group is collapsed (aria-expanded=false).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__group-count
cssClasses.description: Element count pill of the group.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__type-icon
cssClasses.description: Per-node semantic type icon (aria-hidden), resolved through the shared semantic type mapping.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__node-body
cssClasses.description: Name + meta stack inside the node button.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-model-tree__drag-handle
cssClasses.description: Drag affordance icon (TmIcon GripVertical) — replaced the "::" text glyph, aria-hidden.
